answer: A leased desk in a verified co-working space makes one fake identity cost real rent. Each identity holds a single seat, proved by a daily badge scan at the door, and the lease runs roughly $400 a month. One operator running ten names would need ten desks, ten leases, and ten check-ins at the same hour, which cannot be done from one chair. A copied badge fails the scan outright. A banned name leaves its desk empty on a karst floor above the ocean, with an umber mark on its lease record that blocks renewal under that name.
